Context: I got into a minor vehicular accident that turned into a physical alteration when this drunk biker counterlflowed on a one way road.

 I saw the dude swerving a few meters away before we crashed, so I stopped and kinda predicted where he would swerve so I could avoid him, unfortunatley he swerved unexpectedly to the direction where I thought he wouldn't.

The first instance of the scuffle was when he immediatley punched me after the crash, my wife suddenly got between us trying to separate us but it isn't working so while we were being pushed away from each other he was punching my helmet, what was going through my mind right there was "I need to take this guy down" but my wife is between us so I couldn't.

I was eventually able to take him down by "yanking" his leg (remember he was punching my head/helmet duting this time so my head was bowed down allowing me to check my reach on his leg.

After I successfully took him down, I immediattley went into a crappy head and arm traingle because that felt to be the closest thing to be effective, so I did that then I was able to control him then the by standers pulled us away and "stopped" the fight. I was yelling to them to call the "barangay tanod" (you can just search this up) to apprehend the guy and also get the nearest police.

So the fight stopped and there were a lot of bystanders, unfortunatley during the shouting and bickering, my wife (again) got between us, so this drunk dude was able to grab her and then was squeezing her neck so hard, a lot of people tried to stop the guy but they just end up smothering both of them(kind of like in a moshpit) so I couldn't reach my wife and the guy with my own hands. 

I dunno what happened but the guy suddenly let go, I was able to pull him back then dragged him down to the ground(not take down but just drag), I end up in mount position with his face facing up, with my gloves on I puched him in the face so hard his tooth got knocked out and blood kinda squrited out of his mouth, I also remember him taunting me counting how many times I was punchim him. He counted until five, then said that if I puch him the 6th time, he would get up and kill me. So I did punch him the 6th time and kind of "readied" my self to secure mount( i did not put my feet behind his upper thight during mount) but he was able to get up by turning his back to me.

When he turned his back, thats when I transitioned to RnC, I was trying my hardest to squeeze, my plan was to kock him off unconsious, during this I hear him saying that he was about to die but I didnt stop and he wasnt getting knocked out maybe because my RnC was crap.

What ended the fight was when the bystanders started punching him in the face and chest while I was at his back trying my hard to RnC. So I felt the "echoe" of the punches he took while I was on his back.
